productOverview.name: Aethria
productOverview.tagline: Intelligent investment discovery and evaluation system
productOverview.mission: Automate early-stage startup scouting, produce concise investment memos, and score startups against customizable VC rubrics.
productOverview.launchGoal: Demo to 3–5 VC contacts with single-command run and clear scout → memo → score → decision flow.

personas.name: Emma
personas.description: VC analyst at an early-stage fund; triages inbound startup ideas and prepares memos for partners.
pains: No single place for scout → review → decision and memo export
personas.exampleUserStory: As Emma, I want the system to surface scored startups with verdicts and memos so that I can focus on the best leads and share memos with partners.

personas.name: Partner (GP)
personas.description: Partner at a small fund; wants clear YES/NO/MAYBE with rationale and next action.
personas.exampleUserStory: As a partner, I want a clear decision and next action so that I know what to do.

userJourney.name: Land / Enter
userJourney.description: User sees Aethria and Enter System; session stored in localStorage

userJourney.name: Loading
userJourney.description: Loading Intelligence Data for ≥2s while startups fetched

userJourney.name: Main feed
userJourney.description: Work grid of startups; global clock, system bar

userJourney.name: Select startup
userJourney.description: Click card → memo or verdict modal

userJourney.name: Idle timeout
userJourney.description: After 20 min idle, session cleared and user returned to Enter

mvpBacklog.userStory: As a dev, I run python run.py and get backend + frontend + agents.
As Emma, I see a list of startups after entering.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/startups returns data; feed shows cards.

mvpBacklog.userStory: As Emma, I open a startup and see its memo.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/startups/:id/memo returns markdown; modal shows memo.

mvpBacklog.userStory: As Emma, scouts and reviewers run automatically and new startups appear.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: Agents run on interval; new discoveries get reviewed and decided; feed updates on poll.

mvpBacklog.userStory: As Emma, I change settings and agents respect them.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/settings; scouts/reviewers/partners toggles; engines read via settings_loader.

mvpBacklog.userStory: As a partner, I see verdict and next action for each startup.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: Verdict modal shows decision, rationale, next_action, human_review_required.

mvpBacklog.userStory: As a dev, I have one E2E test: scout → review → partner → memo.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: Single test or script that runs pipeline and asserts memo content.

mvpBacklog.userStory: As a PM, we have a short about and success/error copy for demos.
mvpBacklog.acceptanceCriteria: Microcopy doc or constants used in UI.

roadmap.riskMitigation: If no key: document stub/mock for demo

roadmap.qa: Manual pass desktop + one mobile size
Toggle scouts off, confirm no new discoveries

deliverables: Optional copy memo or download in UI

roadmap.qa: E2E green; runbook runnable by new dev

roadmap.riskMitigation: If API key limits: reduce scout/reviewer frequency

metrics.measurement: Count memo API calls or frontend memo opens

apiEndpoints.outputs: 200, array of { id, scout, review?, partner?, timestamps }

entities: Startup (startup_id, scout_info, review_info, partner_info, financials, created_at, updated_at)
dataModel.portfolioStorage: data/portfolio/ (startups.json, decisions.json, portfolio.json, rejections.json, watchlist.json, signals.json, agent_metrics.json)

gaps.detail: New devs may not know OPENAI_API_KEY, STORAGE_PATH, etc.
May slow with 1000s of entries; Postgres planned.
No GitHub Actions or other CI.
primary_thesis, key_assumptions, biggest_unknown from Scouts not on ScoutInfo/adapter; Reviewer lacks them.
Scout does not collect team, competitors, monetization; memos often [MISSING] for those sections.

nextStepsChecklist: Add .env.example with OPENAI_API_KEY, STORAGE_PATH, SETTINGS_PATH, SCOUT_MODEL, REVIEWER_MODEL, PARTNER_USE_LLM, PORTFOLIO_DIR.
Confirm run.py works for a new clone (Python 3.8+, npm install in app-front-end).
Add one integration test that runs Scout → Reviewer → Partner and asserts memo content.
Document demo runbook (start run.py, open http://localhost:3000, Enter, wait for feed).
Add optional E2E test (Playwright/Cypress) for Enter → feed → open memo.
Plan auth and GDPR/data retention before any non-demo deployment.
